sourceSkills.instructions:
You have access to bot-management tools.

- Use `create_bot` to create a trading bot.
- Use `list_bots` to inspect existing bots.
- Use `get_bot_status` to inspect a bot's current state.
- Use `start_bot` to start a bot.
- Use `stop_bot` to stop a bot.
- Use `adjust_bot_config` to update a bot's configuration.
- Use `get_analytics` to inspect bot performance.
- Use `list_positions` to inspect open positions tied to managed bots.
- Use `resolve_bot` to find a bot ID by name or symbol before calling stop_bot, start_bot, get_bot_status, or adjust_bot_config when you don't have the UUID.
- Use `send_message` to report actions, status, or issues to the user.

tools.name: create_bot
tools.description: Create and start a new trading bot with its own strategy and risk parameters.

tools.name: stop_bot
tools.description: Stop a running bot. Positions remain open unless manually closed.

tools.name: start_bot
tools.description: Start a stopped bot. Resumes trading per its configuration.

tools.name: adjust_bot_config
tools.description: Update configuration for a specific bot. Changes merged and take effect next tick.

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List bots created by this agent, optionally filtered by creation date.

tools.name: get_bot_status
tools.description: Get detailed status for a specific bot: config, runtime state, timestamps.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get trading analytics: total trades, win rate, P&L, fees, per-bot/agent-direct breakdown.

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: List open positions owned by this agent (bot-created + direct).

tools.name: resolve_bot
tools.description: Resolve a bot name/symbol to its bot ID for stop/start/config operations.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the user via the platform messaging system. For user-directed communication only — use send_email for email delivery.

sourceSkills.instructions:
You have access to trading tools, grouped by workflow phase.

To observe, gather market context, you can:
- Use `get_market_overview` to inspect broad market state.
- Use `check_regime` to assess current market conditions.
- Use `get_price` for focused price checks.
- Use `get_funding_rates` to inspect perpetual funding conditions.
- Use `search_tokens` to find a token by name or symbol.
- Use `discover_tokens` to explore available trading candidates.

To assess, check your risk and position before acting, you can:
- Use `get_risk_limits` to inspect your effective risk limits and their sources. If you are blocked (e.g. daily loss limit exceeded), DO NOT submit any trade — wait for the cooldown to expire.
- Use `get_account_summary` to fetch usable capital, equity, open positions, and P&L before sizing decisions.
- Use `get_analytics` to inspect recent trading outcomes and exposure.
- Use `list_positions` to inspect current open positions.
- Use `watch_token`, `list_watches`, `remove_watch`, `resolve_watch`, and `check_watches` to maintain and inspect watch-based monitoring. Use resolve_watch to find a watch ID by note or symbol before calling remove_watch.

To decide, you can:
- Use `find_instrument` to resolve an instrumentId by symbol, name, or pair before calling submit_decision. Filter by venue (e.g. venue="jupiter" for Solana, venue="hyperliquid" for perpetuals).
- Use `submit_decision` to submit a trade intent for a specific instrument. Only call this after completing the Observe and Assess phases above.
- Use `adjust_risk_limits` to adjust mutable (default-derived) risk limits within operator ceilings.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Aggregated market overview: top movers, volume leaders, market breadth metrics.

tools.name: check_regime
tools.description: Evaluate market regime using EMA alignment, ADX, VWAP, and structure filters.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Look up current price of a token. Hyperliquid perps use mark price; DEX tokens use oracle price.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Get current funding rates for perpetual contracts.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Search for tokens by name/symbol on DEX aggregators. Returns liquidity, price, safety metadata, network.

tools.name: discover_tokens
tools.description: Discover trending/popular tokens from aggregated market data sources.

tools.name: get_risk_limits
tools.description: Get effective risk limits: which are mutable vs locked, plus runtime state.

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: Agent's trading account summary: capital, equity, open positions, P&L, risk limits.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get trading analytics: total trades, win rate, P&L, fees, per-bot/agent-direct breakdown.

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: List open positions owned by this agent (bot-created + direct).

tools.name: watch_token
tools.description: Register a price watch. Fires when price crosses a threshold in specified direction.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List all active price watches registered by this agent.

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Remove a price watch by its ID.

tools.name: resolve_watch
tools.description: Resolve a price watch to its ID by searching note text or symbol.

tools.name: check_watches
tools.description: Evaluate all active price watches against current prices. Optionally auto-remove triggered.

tools.name: find_instrument
tools.description: Find a tradable instrument by symbol/name. Returns instrumentId (venue-submittable), id (DB internal), symbol, base, quote, type, venue.

tools.name: submit_decision
tools.description: Submit a trade decision for a specific instrument. In direct mode, accepted decisions execute immediately. In approval_required mode, the decision is recorded and sent to the user for approval — no trade executes until the user responds with /yes <code> or /no <code>.

tools.name: adjust_risk_limits
tools.description: Adjust mutable risk limits. Only operator-default-derived limits can be changed.

tools.name: assess_strategy_preset
tools.description: Request a billable market preset assessment for one or more trading symbols. Returns ranked presets, confidence, market summary, and the exact transition reference for change_strategy_preset.

tools.name: change_strategy_preset
tools.description: Apply a strategy preset change using an exact assessment artifact reference from assess_strategy_preset. Supports: entries_only (future entries only) and entries_and_tighten_existing (tighten stops on open positions). Records the transition event for audit.

sourceSkills.instructions:
You have access to risk-monitoring and alerting tools.

- Use `list_positions` to inspect current open positions and exposure.
- Use `get_analytics` to inspect realized and unrealized performance context.
- Use `get_price` for focused price checks.
- Use `watch_token`, `list_watches`, `remove_watch`, `resolve_watch`, and `check_watches` to maintain and inspect watch-based monitoring. Use resolve_watch to find a watch ID by note or symbol before calling remove_watch.
- Use `send_message` to alert the user.
- Use `publish_artifact` to publish structured monitoring outputs.
- Use `get_risk_limits` to inspect effective risk limits and sources.
- Use `get_account_summary` to inspect usable capital, equity, open positions, and P&L when assessing portfolio-level risk.
- Use `adjust_risk_limits` to adjust mutable risk limits within operator ceilings.
